Mamafali Goriya Ps Bali, Dist. Pali.
For Respondent(s) : Mr. SS Rajpurohit, Pp  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MANOJ KUMAR GARG Order 18/12/2023
The petitioner has been arrested in connection with FIR No.208/2021 of Police Station Bali, District Pali for the offence punishable under Sections 376(2)(N), 376(2)(F), 450 IPC.

He has preferred this second bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C.
The first bail application was dismissed as not pressed on 21.11.2022 with liberty to file afresh after recording the statement of the prosecutrix.
Counsel for the petitioner submits that the prosecutrix has been examined before the trial court as PW-1 and in her statement, there are material contradictions, omissions and improvements.
The accused-petitioner is inside the jail since 21.02.2022 and the trial of the case will take [2023:RJ-JD:44182] (2 of 2) [CRLMB-15548/2023] sufficient long time to be concluded.
Therefore, the benefit of bail should be granted to the accused-petitioner.
Learned Public Prosecutor has opposed the second bail application.

Having regard to the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any Ladu Ram vs The State Of Rajasthan ... on 18 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/91290215/
1 opinion on the merits of the case, I deem it just and proper to grant bail to the accused petitioner under Section 439 Cr.P.C.
Accordingly, the second bail application filed under Sec.439 Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is directed that petitioner Ladu Ram S/o Shri Babu Ram shall be released on bail in connection with FIR No.208/2021 of Police Station Bali, District Pali provided he executes a personal bond in a sum of Rs.1,00,000/- with two sound and solvent sureties of Rs.50,000/- each to the satisfaction of learned trial court for his appearance before that court on each and every date of hearing and whenever called upon to do so till the completion of the trial.
(MANOJ KUMAR GARG),J 120-MS/-
